reason: On $40k with a family, $13 a kid plus snacks adds up fast when the library, the park and a free church playgroup cost nothing. I'd take the free first visit maybe, but I wouldn't count on paying after.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? I'd be paying more for the same thing my kids already play at, and I can't see what justifies $13 a head.
would_change_my_mind: A group rate low enough that my moms group could come for about $5 a kid, or proof from other local parents that it's clearly better than CoCo's.
